--- Table 1: adventureworks.production.productcategory ---
Domain: Product
Description: High-level product categorization.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): Business name of the product category (e.g., Bikes, Components, Clothing, Accessories)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp indicating when the product category record was last modified
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each record for database replication and synchronization purposes
  - productcategoryid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for the product category serving as the primary key

--- Table 2: adventureworks.purchasing.productvendor ---
Domain: Purchasing
Description: Cross-reference table mapping vendors with the products they supply.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier linking to the product being sourced from this vendor
  - minorderqty (integer(32,0)): Minimum quantity that must be ordered from this vendor per purchase order
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Vendor (supplier) identifier from the business entity master
  - maxorderqty (integer(32,0)): Maximum quantity allowed per purchase order from this vendor
  - lastreceiptdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when the most recent shipment was received from this vendor
  - lastreceiptcost (numeric): Unit cost paid for the product in the most recent receipt from this vendor
  - unitmeasurecode (character(3)): Standard unit of measure for ordering this product from the vendor (e.g., EACH, CASE)
  - onorderqty (integer(32,0)): Current quantity of this product that has been ordered but not yet received
  - averageleadtime (integer(32,0)): Average number of days between placing an order and receiving the product from this vendor
  - standardprice (numeric): Standard unit price charged by this vendor for the product
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when this vendor-product relationship record was last updated
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.productlistpricehistory ---
Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the list price of a product over time.
Fields:
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The date when this specific list price became effective and applicable for the product
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The date when this specific list price ceased to be applicable (NULL indicates the price is currently active)
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product to which this list price applies
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp when this price history record was last modified in the system
  - listprice (numeric): The monetary value of the product's list price during the specified date range

  - productphotoid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Foreign key referencing the specific product photo record containing the actual image data and metadata
